name: Renewal generation headless bypasses prehook chain (COLA + description null)
what_it_tests: RLM Fortra_Create_Renewal_Quote creates renewal QLIs outside the pricing-procedure reprice context, so prehooks (COLAUpliftPrehook, QLDescriptionGeneratorPrehook) never fire, leaving COLA price and generated description null on all renewal lines
proc_mechanism: initiateRenewal platform API creates QLIs outside reprice; COLAUpliftPrehook + QLDescriptionGeneratorPrehook (registered LAST) only fire during procedure execution; COLAUpliftHandler bails on empty/late QuoteActionId (~35s FK lag)
expected_behavior: Renewal flow must trigger Reprice-All so prehook chain fires, OR move COLA + description onto a post-create trigger/flow; all renewal QLIs get COLA'd UnitPrice and formatted LineItemDescription without manual reprice
test_setup: Renewal quote generated headlessly, 4+ attributes populated, expect COLA'd UnitPrice + pipe-delimited description

prior_run.actual: Fresh headless renewal Quote 0Q0WC000003FcRR0A0 (2 lines, async-settled): Cobalt Strike & beSECURE both have NetUnitPrice=0, TotalPrice=0, COLACalculatedPrice__c=null, Description=null. Only the trigger ran (UnitPrice=6265.8/218.772 = Pre_COLA x1.062, Pre_COLA_Price__c & COLA_Source__c=CMDT Lookup set). Manual Force-reprice (PST API isSuccess=true) then HEALED both lines: COLACalculatedPrice 6265.8/218.77, NetUnitPrice 6265.8/218.77, TotalPrice 18797.4/656.31, Description 'Cobalt Strike | Named User | Expert' / 'beSECURE - Cloud-Based | Devices: 1-10 | One Time | Cloud Based'. Confirms prehook bypass.
prior_run.defectStep: Renewal generation path bypasses V21 entirely: COLAUpliftPrehook feeding 'COLA Uplift Net on Renewal' (step 26) / 'COLA Uplift on Renewal' (steps 27-28, COLACalculatedPrice__c->NetUnitPrice) and QLDescriptionGeneratorPrehook (registered LAST) never execute at headless generation time because Fortra_Create_Renewal_Quote does not trigger Reprice-All.
prior_run.regression: SC-3354/SC-3350 (COLA renewal net+COLACalculatedPrice null) + SC-3349 (renewal line description null)
prior_run.notes: Trigger COLAUpliftHandler does stamp UnitPrice/Pre_COLA_Price__c/COLA_Source__c at insert, but COLACalculatedPrice__c, NetUnitPrice, TotalPrice and Description require the prehook chain which only runs during procedure execution. Defect reproduces 100% on fresh headless renewal; Force-reprice proves root cause is the missing post-create reprice, not the V21 procedure. Active proc V21; QuoteActionId FK lag did not manifest this run (links were set), so the bypass is the procedure-context absence, not the ~35s QuoteActionId lag.
